title: BLFHumanReviewDecision
description: Schema for recording individual blinded native-speaker judgments on candidate linguistic items (Stage 1 Blinded Review).

review_id.description: Unique identifier for this review decision record.

item_id.description: ID of the reviewed candidate item.

pilot_version.description: Version string of the pilot dataset reviewed (e.g. 1.0.0).

reviewer_id_pseudonymous.description: Pseudonymous identifier for the human evaluator (e.g. REV-LINGUIST-01, REV-NATIVE-02).

native_bangladeshi_speaker.description: Whether the reviewer is a native speaker of Bangladeshi Bangla (required for Gold acceptability rating).

native_variety.description: Native dialect/regional background of the reviewer.

region.description: Geographic division or district of origin in Bangladesh.

randomization_seed.description: Randomization seed used to generate the reviewer's candidate permutation.

displayed_candidate_mapping.description: Mapping from displayed labels ('A', 'B', 'C') to canonical candidate IDs.

review_timestamp.description: ISO UTC timestamp of judgment completion.

judgment.description: Categorical acceptability judgment by human rater.

preferred_displayed_candidate.description: The displayed candidate label preferred by the reviewer.

canonical_candidate_id.description: Resolved canonical candidate identifier derived from displayed_candidate_mapping.

correction.description: Suggested natural/grammatical correction in standard orthography if all candidates are flawed.

comments.description: Linguistic notes, register nuances, or dialectal context.

review_record_status.description: Pipeline status of the individual review record (individual decisions cannot self-declare ADJUDICATED_GOLD).
